page.layout: One printed page of running text in a single main column; a narrow sliver of the facing page at the right edge (partial marginal text of the neighbouring page, not transcribed as it belongs to another page). Running head at top: "De sacris scripturis." left and "Lib. 7." right; page number "260" above the head. Scholastic marginal-style brace annotations ("Luc.24.", "44.", "Act.1.10.") sit beside the text inside the column block.

gentibus conuocatæ glorisam administrationem

page.notes: Marginal brace references are printed beside the text ("Luc.24.", "44.", "Act.1.10."); the sliver of the facing page at the right edge is not transcribed. The final word "ones" is partly cut off at the foot and is read as "ones" (possibly "ones" for "ones"); the bottom line is damaged. Several words in the lower lines are partially obscured by the gutter shadow and may be inexact.
